info.title: F&B Platform — Outlet API
info.description: Outlet POS API for the locally assigned catalog, inventory, atomic multi-item sales and receipts. Runs at the outlet site against its own PostgreSQL; sales never depend on HQ reachability. All responses use the `ApiSuccess`/`ApiError` envelopes; money is a decimal string of integer minor units.

outletId.description: Provisioned outlet this account belongs to.

identity.description: True once the outlet identity row exists (setup step 1 done).

hqConnection.description: True once the HQ connection row exists (setup step 2 done).

provisioned.description: True when both setup steps are complete; setup endpoints are sealed from then on.

lastValidatedAt.description: When HQ last accepted the stored key (ISO 8601 UTC).

outletId.description: Outlet UUID copied from the HQ console after outlet creation.

outletCode.description: Outlet code copied from the HQ console (receipt prefix).

adminEmail.description: First admin account email for this terminal.
The admin account created for this terminal.

hqApiBaseUrl.description: HQ sync API base URL reachable from this outlet (versioned /api/v1 root).

keySecret.description: One-time machine key secret shown by HQ at issuance. Transits only this request body.

lastValidatedAt.description: When HQ accepted this key during validation.

highestContiguousSequence.description: HQ contiguous sequence watermark at validation — decimal string.

email.description: Work email; unique at this outlet.

roleCodes.description: Replaces the role set when present.

unitPriceMinor.description: Effective outlet price, integer minor units, decimal string.

availableQuantity.description: On-hand quantity; 0 when no balance row exists.

version.description: Balance row version; bumps on every mutation.

deltaQuantity.description: Signed, nonzero quantity delta applied to on-hand stock (±1,000,000).

quantity.description: Line quantity; duplicates are merged by menuItemId server-side.

items.description: 1..100 distinct lines; duplicate menuItemIds are merged before validation.

name.description: Immutable name snapshot captured at sale time (FR-02).

sku.description: Immutable SKU snapshot captured at sale time.

unitPriceMinor.description: Snapshot unit price, integer minor units, decimal string.

subtotalMinor.description: Line subtotal, integer minor units, decimal string.

totalMinor.description: Total, integer minor units, decimal string.

catalogRevision.description: Local catalog revision the sale was priced against, decimal string.

syncStatus.description: Resolved from the outbox row; separate from sale status (PRD §8.7).

totalMinor.description: Total, integer minor units, decimal string.

active.description: True while the override still extends the grace window.

reason.example: Regional network outage — connector replacement scheduled.

overriddenBy.description: The manager who applied the override.

hours.description: Configured offline grace window in hours (PRD §8.8).

expiresAt.description: Effective grace expiry (window or active override); null when never synced.

expired.description: True once the effective grace expiry has lapsed; new sales are blocked.

override.description: The active emergency override, when one is in force (PRD §8.8).

lastError.description: The terminal error that parked the event.

oldestPendingAt.description: Oldest undelivered event timestamp; null when the outbox is drained.

lastPublishedAt.description: Most recent successful delivery; null when nothing has been delivered yet.

lastErrorSample.description: Quarantined events with their terminal errors, for operator review.

hqApiBaseUrl.description: Stored HQ sync API base URL.

keyId.description: Stored machine key ID (the secret is never returned).

lastValidatedAt.description: When HQ last accepted the stored key.

lastAppliedRevision.description: Last applied HQ catalog revision, decimal string.

lastMenuSyncAt.description: Last successful menu sync; null when never synced.

hqConnection.description: The stored HQ connection (key ID only); null before pairing.

reason.example: Regional network outage; connector replacement scheduled.
